name: Shorty's Bar
description: Shorty's is a lively karaoke bar known for its welcoming atmosphere and diverse entertainment options. It offers a fun environment with pool tables, darts, karaoke, live music, and a dance floor, making it ideal for groups seeking a casual night out. The friendly staff and affordable drinks contribute to its reputation as a great spot for both locals and visitors to enjoy singing and socializing any night of the week.
